verdict.rationale: The patents page names an account gate up front: "Log in to MyCIPO Patents" is the published entry to the patent rail, with keyless public search alongside it. So a founder learns before starting that a MyCIPO account is required for patents. The trademark filing entry only points to an Online services block, and nothing spells out the credential type, the sign-in method, or any identity-proofing steps. Missing for 10: an explicit published list of the account, credential and identity-verification prerequisites for trademark and patent filing; stating that list before the flow begins; any independent or hands-on confirmation that no further walls appear mid-flow.
